reviewTitle: Role-Based Navigation Visibility and Administrator-Configurable Department and Platform Access for Dashboards
summary: Every requested capability is present and working, but the role-grant closure is incomplete on the write path, the security telemetry gate does not consult the access profile, and the staging deployment workflow applies migrations without maintenance mode or a backup. Production release is not approved in the current state.

approval.reason: Departmental information can still be exposed to accounts the access profile excludes: a role grant bypasses the profile for records created after release (S-1), and the security telemetry area does not consult the profile at all (S-2). The staging deployment workflow added on this branch also applies the schema change without maintenance mode or a backup and is not covered by an approved Change Request (S-4).
